title: Spring Boot
intro: Spring Boot interview questions are the single most asked Spring topic — auto-configuration internals, the starter system, application.properties/yml + profiles, Actuator endpoints and security, embedded servers, configuration binding, graceful shutdown, scheduled tasks, layered Docker images, and the troubleshooting questions interviewers pull from real production incidents. This page covers the questions that test whether you have actually shipped Spring Boot to production, not just used start.spring.io. For lower-level Spring concepts (IoC, AOP, transaction internals) see Spring Core; for persistence see Spring Data JPA / Hibernate.
